packageRules.description: A new ps-server/ps-client tag is a release, not a dependency bump: it needs a release-snapshot entry and possibly a capability-registry entry (documentation/39-release-procedure.md), and not every pushed tag is a release (ps-server:3.29 is a CI-verification build that Renovate proposed in PR #12). Digest updates for the same tag stay enabled - tags are never moved, so one would be an incident worth seeing.

Confirmed live 2026-09-23: Renovate proposed 1.31.6 as an update to the pinned 1.30.5, but 1.31.x is nginx's mainline release line, not a newer stable one (nginx:stable still resolved to 1.30.5 at the same time). Renovate has no notion of this split - it only sees version numbers - so this pins it to the 1.30.x line until a human deliberately updates this regex, which should happen only after confirming nginx:stable has actually moved (see release/approved-digests.json's nginx entry for how to check).

Confirmed live 2026-09-23: the 26.3.2 -> 26.7.4 bump passed review but broke every authenticated portal API call (401). Keycloak 26.4.12/26.6.2/26.7.0+ refuse token introspection by a client that is not in the token's aud (CVE-2026-37979 fix), and ps-server introspects portal tokens as padsign-backend. This is fixed by the padsign-backend-audience mapper (keycloak-bootstrap.sh for new realms, upgrade.sh's keycloak-backend-audience migration for existing ones). This rule holds Keycloak on the 26.7.x line that fix was verified against. Before widening the regex to a new minor, run a real portal login plus an introspection as padsign-backend (or verify-keycloak.sh plus an authenticated ps-server call) against that version - see documentation/14-08-token-audience-for-introspection.md.

prBodyNotes: **DMSS image bump: do not approve on the diff alone.** Check out this branch and run `./installation-scripts/dmss-seal-smoke.sh` (boots the pinned container-signature + digital-stamping images against this repo's config in an isolated compose project, then does 3 consecutive local e-seals). Paste its output into the review and approve only on `PASSED`. See documentation/39-release-procedure.md.
packageRules.description: DMSS images get their own PR (not bundled with keycloak/nginx/ps-* digests) and a mandatory boot + seal check, because a bump can pass every file-level check and still not work with this repo's config: container-signature 24.3.3.9 (Renovate #12) doesn't start without spring.mail.* (application.yml now sets it), and 24.3.0.43 through 24.3.3.9 rewrite the B_BES LocalDemo profile to PAdES-BASELINE-LT after its first seal. Both were found only by booting the image and sealing more than once.

Stops Renovate re-proposing the container-signature tags that don't work with this repo's config (pin reverted to 24.3.0.29 on 2026-09-23, psapp-saas#14): 24.3.0.35 and 24.3.0.37-24.3.0.40 (stamping answers "Company 'null' not found"), and 24.3.0.43 through 24.3.3.9 (the B_BES LocalDemo profile ratchets to PAdES-BASELINE-LT after its first seal; 24.3.3.9 also needs spring.mail.* to start, which application.yml now provides; with it, seals 2+ fail 422 on the LT upgrade). Tested with dmss-seal-smoke.sh: 0.35, 0.37, 0.38, 0.39, 0.40, 0.43, 0.46, 0.48, 0.49, 3.9 failed; 0.29, 0.30, 0.34, 0.36 passed. The untested tags inside the blocked range sit between failing ones. 24.3.0.36, 24.3.3.10+, 24.3.4+ and 26.x are still proposed, and still go through dmss-seal-smoke.sh (26.7.1.1, the newest when this was written, failed it the same way).
